text:
The change lets callers initialize a cart with items, but its default list is shared by every cart created without an explicit list. Adding a 450-cent item to Ana’s cart makes a newly created Bo cart total 450 cents too. This breaks cart isolation and can produce incorrect charges.

The tests miss this because only one cart uses the default argument; the new test supplies its own list.
